name: ai-air-drawing
description: Modular AI Air Drawing System - 21 independent packages for gesture-based drawing, AI assistance, and diagram recognition

scripts.build:packages*: for package in $(ls packages); do echo "Building package: $package"; (cd packages/$package && npm run build || echo "Build failed for $package") ; done
scripts.lint:packages: for package in $(ls packages); do echo "Linting package: $package"; (cd packages/$package && npm run lint || echo "Lint failed for $package") ; done
scripts.test:packages: for package in $(ls packages); do echo "Testing package: $package"; (cd packages/$package && npm run test || echo "Test failed for $package") ; done
scripts.clean: for package in $(ls packages); do (cd packages/$package && rm -rf dist node_modules tsconfig.tsbuildinfo 2>/dev/null); done && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json .lerna-cache
